evidence.claim: U.S. Census reported Q1 2026 adjusted retail ecommerce sales of $326.7 billion, up 2.7% from Q4 2025 and up 9.8% year over year; ecommerce accounted for 16.9% of total retail sales.
evidence.source_title: Monthly Retail Trade - Quarterly Retail E-Commerce Sales Report

evidence.claim: NRF and Happy Returns projected 2025 U.S. retail merchandise returns of $849.9 billion, estimated online returns at 19.3% of online sales, and identified return fraud as 9% of returns.
Mastercard Economics Institute's 2026 travel research frames the travel economy around macro forces, AI's influence on travel, and changing traveler priorities.
evidence.source_title: The travel economy in 2026: How travelers adapt to uncertainty

evidence.claim: Synchrony describes itself as offering private-label, co-brand, general-purpose credit cards and installment loans, and its 2025 filing states it launched a Walmart/OnePay partnership to become exclusive issuer of general-purpose and private-label card programs at Walmart.

John B. Sanfilippo & Son states that it manufactures or processes food and snack products under its own brands and private brands, and sells through food retailers, commercial ingredient users, and contract-manufacturing customers.

Lancaster Colony reported Retail segment sales support from licensed programs including Texas Roadhouse dinner rolls and Chick-fil-A sauce club-channel expansion, and disclosed Foodservice sales from a temporary supply agreement tied to the Atlanta sauce and dressing facility acquisition.
evidence.source_title: Lancaster Colony Reports Third Quarter Sales and Earnings

evidence.claim: BlueLinx discloses revenue by specialty and structural product categories; fiscal 2025 specialty product net sales were about $2.05 billion and structural product net sales were about $901 million.
Installed Building Products' 2025 annual report disaggregates Installation segment revenue by end market and product, including repair and remodel.

PROG Holdings' 2025 Form 10-K states it has Progressive Leasing, an in-store, app-based, and ecommerce point-of-sale lease-to-own solutions provider, and Four Technologies; Progressive Leasing serves POS partner locations and ecommerce website partners.

CSW Industrials' filings describe Contractor Solutions, Specialized Reliability Solutions, and Engineered Building Solutions, with products for HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, building safety, specialty lubricants, sealants, and distribution operations across several regions.
evidence.source_title: CSW Industrials Quarterly Report for period ended December 31, 2025

evidence.claim: CSW's annual-report disclosure says HVAC/R represented 59% of fiscal 2026 net revenue and that the HVAC/R industry is driven by replacement and repair of existing systems as well as new construction; sales are driven through a global distribution network to contractors.

Descartes reported fiscal 2025 growth and described its Global Logistics Network as serving shippers, carriers, and logistics providers amid global trade complexity, tariffs, sanctions, and connected trading-partner needs.
evidence.source_title: Descartes Announces Fiscal 2025 Fourth Quarter and Annual Financial Results

evidence.claim: Descartes' Q3 fiscal 2026 shareholder report describes focus on logistics and supply-chain management and notes ecommerce as a driver of logistics complexity.
PROS describes airline retailing and offer-management capabilities that create, price, distribute, and market optimized offers in real time across channels.
evidence.source_title: PROS AI-Powered Airline Retailing & Offer Management

evidence.claim: PRO may be an underfollowed travel-infrastructure exposure if it remains publicly investable and if airline NDC, AI travel search, and ancillary pricing increase demand for specialized airline offer-management software.
evidence.source_title: PROS AI-Powered Airline Retailing & Offer Management

memory_update.text: SYF should remain a reference anchor, not the main underfollowed alpha lane, for consumer-credit enablement because it defines partner scale, private-label card economics, credit-loss sensitivity, and regulatory risk.

PRG maps cleanly to the underfollowed checkout-finance node: in-store, app-based, and ecommerce POS lease-to-own/BNPL for near-prime and subprime consumers, with key variables being GMV, write-offs, approval discipline, and partner concentration.

JBSS and LANC map to private-label/value food infrastructure where the hidden bottleneck is certified food manufacturing, sourcing, formulation, packaging, retailer or restaurant-chain qualification, and cold-chain/production capacity rather than consumer brand heat.

BXC, IBP, and CSW form a repair/remodel contractor-infrastructure cluster: distribution, installed labor capacity, and HVAC/R/plumbing pro-trade consumables can benefit even when consumer-facing housing narratives focus on retailers or homebuilders.

DSGX maps to the retail/logistics connectivity node but needs segment-purity work because customs, routing, transportation management, and global trade compliance may dilute direct retail/ecommerce exposure.
PRO requires immediate verification of current public-market status, ticker continuity, and segment purity before it can remain in the public-company candidate universe.

Need market-cap, liquidity, analyst-coverage, short-interest, valuation, and revenue-purity checks for all tickers before Layer 3 ranking; current Layer 2B only maps industrial relationships and evidence quality.
Need customer-concentration and top-customer dependency verification for JBSS, LANC, PRG, BXC, IBP, CSW, and DSGX to separate true chokepoints from low-margin vendor exposure.

summary: Mapped ticker relationships for a Consumer candidate chunk focused on second-order infrastructure nodes: consumer-credit enablement, private-label/value food manufacturing, repair/remodel contractor supply, logistics/trading-partner connectivity, and travel retailing software. Reference anchor is SYF. Underfollowed candidates with the clearest node fit are PRG for second-look checkout finance, JBSS/LANC for private-label and foodservice manufacturing capacity, BXC/IBP/CSW for repair/remodel contractor infrastructure, DSGX for logistics/trading-partner networks, and PRO as a travel-offer-management software exposure that requires public-status and segment-purity verification.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Whether Synchrony is gaining merchant share and improving approval/decisioning economics despite consumer-credit stress, or whether delinquencies, charge-offs, funding costs, and regulatory pressure overwhelm retail-conversion benefits.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Track monthly credit-card master trust data, net charge-off and delinquency trends, purchase volume, retailer partner additions/losses, Walmart/OnePay ramp commentary, and CFPB/late-fee litigation or rule changes.
ticker_relationships.node: Consumer-credit enablement: private-label cards, co-brand cards, installment lending, merchant financing, fraud and decisioning rails
ticker_relationships.relationship: Reference leader for retailer-integrated credit infrastructure; calibrates what merchant scale, partner breadth, credit-loss sensitivity, promotional financing, and private-label card integration look like at large scale.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Private-brand channel growth, contract-manufacturing sales, snack-bar facility utilization, nut commodity procurement spreads, customer concentration, food-safety record, and retailer program wins.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Pull latest 10-K/10-Q channel revenue by consumer, commercial ingredients, and contract manufacturing; compare volume versus price; check customer-concentration disclosures and capex/utilization after the snack-bar acquisition.
ticker_relationships.node: Private-label and value-oriented consumer staples manufacturing: nut processing, snack bars, commercial ingredients, contract manufacturing
ticker_relationships.relationship: Underfollowed manufacturer tied to retailer private-brand, club-store snacking, commercial ingredient, and contract-manufacturing demand; processing, food-safety, sourcing, roasting, packaging, and customer qualification can create operational switching friction.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Concentration among national chain restaurant accounts, licensed/private-label sauce program expansion, private-label mix shift, cold-chain or production constraints, and margin pass-through on oils, eggs, dairy, packaging, and freight.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Verify latest annual report segment disclosures for Retail versus Foodservice, licensed-brand contribution, Winland Atlanta sauce/dressing facility contribution, customer concentration, and margin commentary.
ticker_relationships.node: Private-label, licensed-brand, and foodservice specialty-food manufacturing: sauces, dressings, bakery and refrigerated/frozen distribution
ticker_relationships.relationship: Potential second-order beneficiary of retailers and restaurant chains expanding licensed sauces, private-label products, club-channel products, and outsourced foodservice manufacturing where formulation, food safety, and chain qualification are barriers.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Whether specialty-products mix and repair/remodel exposure offset structural-product commodity volatility; track volumes, pricing, working capital, fleet investments, gross margin by product category, and end-market exposure.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Use 2025 annual report and 2026 quarterly results to track specialty versus structural revenue, gross margins, inventory turns, free cash flow, and repair/remodel versus new-construction mix.
ticker_relationships.node: Home repair/remodel contractor supply: building-products wholesale distribution, specialty products, structural products, dealer and branch logistics
ticker_relationships.relationship: Second-order housing repair/remodel exposure through product availability, branch/fleet distribution, specialty building-products mix, and contractor/dealer service levels rather than consumer-facing home-improvement retail.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Whether repair/remodel revenue grows faster than new construction, and whether labor availability, branch density, acquisition integration, or insulation-code complexity creates durable pricing power.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Confirm latest annual report revenue disaggregation by end market and product; track same-branch sales, repair/remodel revenue growth, acquisition contribution, installer labor cost, and gross margin.
ticker_relationships.node: Home repair/remodel and energy-efficiency installation capacity: insulation and complementary installed building products
ticker_relationships.relationship: Represents installed-labor capacity rather than just product distribution; demand from energy-efficiency upgrades, repair/remodel, and code-compliant insulation can be constrained by trained installer availability, branch density, and local execution.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: GMV growth by POS partner channel, annual write-off targets, approval-rate discipline, loss of major partner locations, and whether retailer partner concentration is increasing or decreasing.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Track Progressive Leasing GMV, active doors/ecommerce partners, annual write-offs, partner concentration, Big Lots/American Signature location-loss impact, Purchasing Power integration, and regulatory or consumer-credit deterioration.
ticker_relationships.node: Consumer-credit enablement: point-of-sale lease-to-own, BNPL, second-look checkout finance, near-prime/subprime retail conversion
ticker_relationships.relationship: Underfollowed checkout-finance rail for consumers who may not qualify for prime credit; merchant value proposition is approval-rate lift at POS/ecommerce checkout for durable goods and discretionary categories.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: How much revenue is truly repair/replacement versus new construction; whether HVAC/R and contractor-product acquisitions increase share of wallet with professional trades without diluting margins.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Disaggregate Contractor Solutions revenue, HVAC/R end-market percentage, organic versus acquisition growth, gross margin after Aspen/MARS/PF WaterWorks/PSP integration, and distributor sell-through.
ticker_relationships.node: Home repair/remodel contractor products: HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, building-safety, sealants, condensate management, grilles/registers/diffusers and pro-trade consumables
ticker_relationships.relationship: Messy diversified-industrial wrapper hides repeated-purchase contractor-product exposure; HVAC/R replacement and repair demand can pull through niche consumables, components, and accessories distributed through pro-trade channels.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: How much revenue or customer activity comes from retail/ecommerce B2B messaging versus customs, routing, transportation management, and acquisition-driven modules.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Review FY2026 shareholder reports and MD&A for Global Logistics Network growth, customer count, ecommerce acquisition contribution such as Finale Inventory, recurring revenue, and retail/customer vertical mix.
ticker_relationships.node: Retail supplier connectivity and logistics-network software: B2B messaging, customs, routing, transportation management, ecommerce inventory and trading-partner networks
ticker_relationships.relationship: Second-order ecommerce and retail-logistics infrastructure play; less retail-pure than SPS Commerce but exposed to the need for connected trading partners, shipment visibility, customs compliance, and ecommerce inventory orchestration.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Whether airline retailing, NDC, AI search interfaces, and dynamic ancillary pricing increase dependence on specialized offer-management engines rather than commoditizing them; also verify current public-company status and ticker continuity.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Verify whether PRO remains publicly listed after any corporate actions; if public, pull latest 10-K/10-Q for airline segment purity, subscription revenue, customer wins, ARR/NRR, profitability path, and exposure to NDC or AI-enabled airline retailing.
ticker_relationships.node: Travel distribution rails: airline retailing, revenue management, dynamic pricing, NDC/direct distribution, offer and ancillary pricing engines
ticker_relationships.relationship: Travel-infrastructure exposure to the shift from static fares to real-time airline retailing and channel-specific offer construction; may benefit if AI travel agents and NDC increase demand for specialized pricing and offer-management engines.
